title: Record the Mantel edge cap
body:
## Summary
- Every graph on at most 7 vertices with more than `floor(n^2/4)` edges contains a triangle. There are 407,058 such graphs.
- The balanced complete bipartite graph meets the count and is triangle-free, and `floor(n/2)*ceil(n/2) = floor(n^2/4)` for every `n` through `2^20`.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
